purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a pump-surety renewal and failure-cost dispute at Cistern House Nine.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary inspection work, the rune-mite reveal, classification pressure, district cost arrival, four payment routes, and their state-gated aftermaths.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the two-level cistern establishing shot, the renewal table, the first preparation, the stopped-pump reveal, cause classification, the arriving water queue, the payment threshold, and each ending family. The twelfth pump stroke and the copper refusal plate receive distinct focal frames.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt is a complete frame for a general image model. It states camera distance, room geometry, materials, light, machinery, visible bodies, tools, and evidence. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise dark ink lines, restrained mineral watercolor, carved basalt and worn brass, warm amber work lamps against cold blue and violet mana light, practical rune machinery, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, dry civic tension, unlettered graphic surfaces.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image prompt from the global_style_cue, one scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups listed as visible in that scene, and each triggered state_image_modifier or global_branch_image_modifier. Render each frame from a camera-specific scene-set blockout when one becomes available.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture reuses one two-level pump house across wide, medium, close, landing, and intake-facing views. The structured map fixes zones, routes, staging, sightlines, and state anchors for draft replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency multi-angle rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout with the public landing, yellow line, dry gallery, inspection table, three-pump service floor, grated stair, wet intake, conduit arch, reserve locker, and fixed camera slots.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a two-level underground civic pump house carved into dark basalt beside a warm subterranean sea. A dry upper gallery opens from a public stone landing; a yellow painted line and large black slate mark the public boundary. A grated iron stair descends to a misty wet intake chamber with black water. Three squat brass-and-iron pump engines stand left to right behind a waist-high brass safety rail, their vertical rods descending into mist, glass pressure floats and long outlet valves facing the gallery. A locked arched conduit in the wall carries cold blue mana light. A barred crystal locker glows faintly beside an inspection table. A terrace water gauge has calm white marks above one red mark. Four compact dwarf workers occupy the gallery as small figures under amber lamps.

visible_characters.default_stance: beside the inspection table with square brass seal at her belt
cleaning Engine One's pressure float behind the rail
writing on the public slate beyond the yellow line
seated at the inspection table with red rule and thick ledger

visual_continuity_notes: Pump order is Engine One nearest the public landing, Engine Two centered, Engine Three nearest the wall conduit and reserve locker.
The public landing and slate are on the dry upper level; the wet intake is visible only through the grated stair opening and gaps around the pump rods.

Behind the safety rail, a compact younger dwarf journeyworker in moss-green coveralls wipes the glass float on the leftmost of three brass pumps. Beyond a yellow line, a sturdy dwarf clerk in a teal wool coat chalks tank margin, blue crystal reserve, and debt marks onto a large public slate. Amber lamps illuminate worn brass; cold blue mana shines through the locked wall conduit.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Pivotal close-up inside an underground rune pump: an opened brass return housing exposes a branching gold channel gone dim. Six thumbnail-sized blue-black mites cling along the same branches; each hard shell has raised grooves matching the gold rune beneath it, and the grooves emit dull violet heat as they absorb the last cold blue mana. A real iron isolation wedge with red shoulder sits fully inserted at the conduit throat. In the middle distance, a compact dwarf journeyworker in moss-green coveralls holds a glass inspection phial and brush while a broad gray-braided dwarf Master completes a right-to-left null gesture. Warm mist rises behind the brass rail from black water below.

visible_characters.default_stance: hand finishing a null gesture beside the isolated pump
holding phial and brush clear of the live channel

visual_continuity_notes: The shell grooves visibly resemble the standardized branching rune but remain biological structures, preserving causal uncertainty.
Engine One remains physically isolated throughout the classification scene.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium view of cause classification around the opened leftmost pump in a carved basalt cistern. A broad older dwarf woman with long gray braid and square brass seal stands between four concrete options: a glass phial for two living blue-black rune-grooved mites; a shallow white lime tray and brush; the bolted housing of the idle center pump ready for comparison; and the rightmost backup pump with a black duty notch on its lever. A younger dwarf journeyworker in moss-green coveralls keeps tools beside the isolated engine. At the inspection table a narrow assessor in charcoal coat turns a copper refusal plate face-up. Beyond the yellow line a teal-coated dwarf clerk copies shell grooves onto a public slate as the terrace water gauge falls.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Open district moot on a broad basalt landing outside a civic pump house. A gray-braided dwarf Master and teal-coated dwarf clerk carry a large black public slate between them; its chalk blocks represent water, debt, cause, and custody. A low stone table holds Talla's single square brass seal at the center and four clean pledge spaces around it. Masters from a bakery, lift repair shop, clinic store, and laundry stand behind those spaces. A compact moss-green journeyworker stands with pump tools behind the gathering, visibly present and outside the ring of seals. Copper water vessels, a wheeled bakery trough, laundry cart, public gauge, and the pump-house arch tie the political meeting to material need.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Delving-contract aftermath at the grated stair of an underground civic pump house. A broad gray-braided dwarf Master holds her square brass seal above a parchment work contract on a small board beside the stair descending into warm mist and black water. A compact journeyworker in moss-green coveralls holds a glass phial of blue-black rune-grooved mites, a chalked groove map, and an intake-route slate beside an empty provision bench with three hooded lamps, three coiled ropes, shields, specimen boxes, and empty salvage packs arranged for possible claimants. A teal-coated public clerk posts a red water clock behind them. The isolated left pump, brass rail, vertical rods, locked blue mana conduit, and public vessel queue remain visible in the full high-fantasy industrial space.

transferring phial, route slate, and groove map

global_branch_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: Open Engine One's brass return housing in clean order; arrange bolts on white cloth while Neri calls each seal and Osric measures beside Talla.
Write a large two-mark safe-water clock and the unpaid assessment as separate bold chalk rows on Poma's outward-facing slate.
Seat one bright blue crystal shaving in Engine One's starter fork; raise the water gauge and add a fresh emergency-charge mark on the public slate.
Place Neri halfway down the grated stair with a hooded lamp and hooked scraper, warm mist around their boots, blue-black shell fragments visible on the tool.
Show two living blue-black grooved mites sealed in a glass phial, Poma copying their branching shell pattern, and Osric turning the copper refusal plate face-up.
Brush the mites into a shallow white lime tray; leave the specimen space empty and place a clean covered-vermin mark in Osric's ledger.
Open the center pump's unused return plate and reveal three pale scratches crossing the same branching points while Osric measures them with the red rule.
Push Engine Three's lever past its black duty notch; show the right pump vibrating, warm spray striking the grate, and violet heat gathering along one gold channel.

Stamp the copper plate with a clean covered-claim mark, wheel a matched brass-and-gold return assembly into the painted delivery bay at Engine One, raise the water gauge, and add one new assessment row to the public slate.
Stamp the copper plate as refused, place the face-down freight plaque alone in the empty painted delivery bay, keep Engine One dark, and lower the water gauge toward red.
Fill the four pledge spaces around Talla's central seal with distinct bakery, lift, clinic, and laundry workshop seals, and hold the household-assessment chalk row unchanged on Poma's slate.
Keep the four pledge spaces visibly bare stone around Talla's single seal and add a fresh temporary household-assessment row beneath the red water clock.

Move one bright crystal allotment from the locker into a repair cradle, wheel a matched assembly into the painted delivery bay, raise the water gauge, lower the winter-heat gauge, and place a life-service freight plaque on the assembly.
Show the reserve tray nearly dark, the painted delivery bay holding only a face-down freight plaque, and the terrace water gauge in red.
Place three equipped delvers in layered leather and mail at the provision bench, each taking a hooded lamp and rope while accepting the sealed contract, phial, groove map, and route slate.

Show the contract board with a bare seal block, the three sets of delving gear still arranged on the empty provision bench, the phial and route slate in Neri's hands, and the public water clock in red beside the ration queue.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in a scene.

characters.talla_venn: Master Talla Venn: broad middle-aged dwarf woman, compact square silhouette, warm brown skin, long iron-gray braid threaded through one brass bead, heavy brows, brown work tunic under an oxblood leather pump apron, thick boots, square brass civic seal on a belt chain, two pale gold-channel burn scars across the first two fingers of her right hand; posture planted, economical, and accustomed to owning a decision.
characters.neri_ash: Neri Ash: young adult dwarf journeyworker, compact sturdy build, copper-brown skin, short black hair with one narrow braided side lock, moss-green canvas coveralls, rolled sleeves, dark leather tool belt, brass-capped boots, small glass inspection phial and cloth-wrapped tool roll; posture precise around live machinery, humor shown through one raised brow and careful hands.
characters.poma_reed: Poma Reed: sturdy adult dwarf clerk, tawny skin, dark coiled hair pinned with two chalk sticks, teal wool coat over a slate-gray tunic, broad chalk-stained fingers, small ledger pouch, large black public slate nearby; posture square to the public landing, eyes moving between gauge, custody, and queue.
characters.osric_vale: Osric Vale: narrow older dwarf man, light brown skin, close-cropped silver hair and pointed silver beard, charcoal reserve-house coat with red piping, black leather ledger case, long red brass measuring rule, palm-sized copper refusal plate; posture straight-backed and deliberately courteous, hands kept clean and visible.

groups.terrace_water_users: Terrace water users: mixed Hold residents in worn high-fantasy work clothing, mostly compact dwarves with a short halfling bakery porter and a lean goblin clinic runner, carrying hammered copper cans, stoppered clinic vessels, a wheeled wooden bakery trough, and a laundry cart with cooling wet sheets; orderly queue posture tightens as the red water mark approaches.

review_notes: Visual continuity self-review verdict: accepted_with_minor_revisions. Eleven scene anchors and sixteen branch or ending modifiers cover every focal shift and material visible consequence; all named visible characters resolve through stable refs.

Spatial-geometric cohesion self-review verdict: accepted_with_minor_revisions. The structured scene_set fixes two levels, pump order, public and work boundaries, access routes, staging reach, sightlines, custody objects, and four branch-persistent physical states.

Shared ending bases use neutral visible anchors: empty delivery bays, bare workshop pledge spaces, and an unclaimed delving provision bench. Success and failure modifiers add their own objects and postures.
All base prompts use affirmative visible descriptions and state the relevant room geometry, materials, light, characters, interfaces, tools, and branch evidence.
The scene_set is a draft map, not a rendered blockout. High-consistency multi-angle image generation remains deferred until a plan view or simple 3D blockout exists.
